name: stave
description: A TUI-inspired Subsonic/Navidrome music client — PWA and Android app

scripts.lint: pnpm lint:format && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.android:sync: pnpm build && cap sync android && sh scripts/android-media-session.sh
scripts.android:build: pnpm build && cap sync android && sh scripts/android-media-session.sh && sh scripts/patch-aapt2.sh && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: pnpm build && cap sync android && sh scripts/android-media-session.sh && sh scripts/android-sign-setup.sh && sh scripts/patch-aapt2.sh && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: pnpm build && cap sync android && sh scripts/android-media-session.sh && sh scripts/android-sign-setup.sh && sh scripts/patch-aapt2.sh && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
